===Etymology===
From {{com|en|host|name}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|en-uk-hostname.ogg|a=UK}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|networking}} The [[unique]] [[name]] by which any [[device]] attached to a [[computer]] [[network]] is known.
#: {{syn|en|domain name|nodename|q2=obsolete}}
# {{lb|en|computing|Internet}} A computer or other network device's [[Internet]] [[domain name]]; a [[fully qualified hostname]].
# {{lb|en|computing|Internet}} The portion of a computer's [[Internet]] [[domain name]] that comes before the first [[period]]; an [[unqualified hostname]].
